label: models/fw_console.mdl: a control console, waist high, dials, two screens, a row of switches

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/sentry.mdl, models/filecabinet.mdl, models/w_egon.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked A, D, C, C where the asset was D, B, B, D: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The outline reads as a waist-high control console: a low box body with a tall back riser carrying the two screens, and a sloped top deck. The left, right and back views show the riser and deck the brief's words imply, with no part sticking out or missing.

M2.reason: Height is 42.5 units against the brief's 40, 6.3% over, within the 15% band. The footprint is 49 by 25.2 and the brief gives no other size.

M3.reason: Two screens (LEVEL 07 and FLOW 000, front and oblique views) and a row of eight switches on the front panel (four red, four grey, front view) are clearly there. The dials are painted on the top deck: they show as three round dials only in the TOP view. In the FRONT-LEFT and FRONT-RIGHT views the deck reads as a pale streaked strip, so the dials do not read clearly at game size. The small latch on the lower door and the dark slot under it are extras the brief does not ask for.

M4.reason: Grey-green painted metal and concrete-like panels with rust streaks, dark green glass-like screens with green text, red and grey switches. These fit the brief's rusted steel and control-panel materials and show no region in a colour that breaks the palette.

M5.reason: Surface detail is in place: the bevelled edges, the panel inset on the front, the screen lettering, the switch row on its black strip, and the rust streaks on the sides and back. Sharpness matches the rest of the set.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the line-up measure. In the four line-up readings the judges never picked the asset as the one not made by Valve; their picks were other models (A, D, C, C) against the asset's positions (D, B, B, D). The asset passed as one of the game's.

M7.reason: The screens and switch row face front. The console is upright, its flat bottom sits on the ground in the BELOW view, and the tall riser is at the back, as the brief's console implies.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors. 60 triangles is far under twice the Half-Life median of 238. Underside, back, sides and top are closed; the BELOW view shows a solid flat base and nothing open is visible from any side.
